title: My mobile game launches in 14 days and pre-registration is open! What are your thoughts?
author: mythagongames
selftext:
Hey everyone!

After a full year of solo development, my mobile action survivor / bullet-hell **Abyss: The Last Reach** is officially launching in 14 days.

The core hook: attacks and abilities never just disappear on hit—they continuously bounce and ricochet across the arena walls and swarms, creating escalating chain reactions.

Key features:

• **Endless Ricochet Mechanics:** High-tempo projectile physics and screen clearing synergies.

• **Local Wi-Fi Co-Op:** Play side-by-side with a friend over the same local network.

• **Deep Progression:** 25 runes and 30 active/passive skills for build variety.

• **Multi-Phase Bosses:** Handcrafted bullet-hell patterns demanding sharp positioning.

Pre-registration is currently live on Google Play if you'd like to support an indie launch:

📲 **Google Play Pre-Register:**

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mythagon.abyssthelastreach

🍏 **iOS / App Store:** Porting is underway, coming soon!

comments.author: Civil-Rip1302
comments.body:
Highly suggest you change the cover. Everything else looks great.

The cover looks a little way too GPT coded. Can turn off a lot of users. But that’s just to be on the safer side.

I think the rest is great!

replies.author: mythagongames
replies.body:
Thanks a lot for the honest feedback! Really appreciate it. You make a solid point about the cover—I'll definitely rework it using actual in-game renders and assets before the official launch so it doesn't give off that vibe. Glad you liked the rest of the game!

Also, don't forget to hit pre-register if you haven't yet! 🫡
